name: What factors determine the cost of interior door painting?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of interior door painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to paint interior doors depends on whether you paint just the door slab or include the jambs, casings, and surrounding trim. Paneled doors take more labor than smooth slabs because of detailed brushwork around recessed sections. Other factors include whether hardware needs to be removed, if older finishes require oil-to-latex transition primers, or if extensive sanding and wood patching are needed. Combining door painting with wider interior trim or drywall repairs lowers the per-door setup cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on door design (paneled vs. flat), whether jambs and trim are included, prep needs like sanding or patching, and hardware removal.
